predictions.name: proximity_utilization_envelope
predictions.statement: On segment utilization maxima through 4e8-5e8 and the 4e8-5e8 o_q branch-max panel, proximity utilization u(r) = D(r)/C_dyn(q) satisfies 0.55 <= u <= 0.98 (endpoint budget pressure; not Tau4 multiset RC48-RC50; not Dual renorm; residual panel audit only — not Target S1*).
